source: GPSJam daily H3 grid / archived regional aggregation
data_note: 复用现存区域汇总计数；不是本轮重新聚合，不是原始航空器轨迹。good/bad为各H3网格航空器分类计数之和，并非区域去重航空器数。

units.bad: sum of count_bad_aircraft across selected cells
units.good: sum of count_good_aircraft across selected cells
units.total: sum of good + bad counts across selected cells
